page.layout: One column of running text under the running head. Above it, the title of the work as a numbered heading in large type. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right, gathering signature at the lower left.

main_text.l: Orationis meæ, Rex meus ac Deus meus,
Dixi enim in excessu mentis meæ, projectus
sum à facie oculorum tuorum, at tu exaudisti
vocem orationis meæ cùm ad te clamarem.
quis sustinebit? Sed apud Te propitiatio est &
Agnosco peccata mea coram Te, quæ Conditio
meorum peccata eo usque mihi imputanda, qua-
tenus illam quam dedisti Potestatem in Tuam
Gloriam & Populi Bonum non exerui. Tu Me

page.notes: The running head is printed in Greek capitals; the second word was read as ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ from the scan, where the lambda is faint and could be misread. The catchword "nunc" and the signature "L" are at the foot. Show-through and cut edges at the left border are not transcribed.
